master.prompt:
Create one complete loaded truck, delta-heron-12. Brief: 

- Vehicle: olive 4×4 pickup scout with an open bed
- Load (drawn as part of the vehicle): a yellow skid-mounted diesel generator
- Equipment: rear spare carrier and ladder
- Finish: mud-caked lower panels
- Tires: 1.30 m mud-terrain: deep chunky mud lugs with open voids

. Secure load with straps or rails, realistic proportions; higher tier stronger and better equipped.  strictly flat 2D side profile, camera perpendicular to the near side at hub height, no perspective, all tires the same size on one level line, no far-side tires. Facing right. Exactly two axles and TWO identical circular visible road wheels, centred rims, horizontal chassis and level tire bottoms. No cab front face visible. Premium semi-realistic painted game illustration in Swamp Scout style, dark contours, weathered materials, fine mechanical details, mud-caked lower panels. Soft even daylight, full object with generous margins all sides, true transparent background. No ground, cast shadow, text, logos, watermark. Wide PNG at least 1500 pixels across.

body.prompt: Edit target delta-heron-12 assembled master. Remove only BOTH road tires and rims, retaining attached spare tire if any. Fill wheel wells with opaque painted dark inner liner, chassis, axle and suspension from fender lip down to original hub line, including every gap. No transparency above hubs; below hub line and under chassis stays transparent. Keep load, equipment and all other details EXACTLY unchanged. Preserve exact canvas dimensions, pixel position, scale and camera. Do not shift or redesign. strictly flat 2D side profile, camera perpendicular to the near side at hub height, no perspective, all tires the same size on one level line, no far-side tires. True transparent background.

- Equipment: rear spare carrier and ladder
- Finish: mud-caked lower panels
